Container.Name: PosterView

Branch.TagDescription: Experimental builds. Use separate appdata for testing.

Container.Overview: Self-hosted artwork and metadata manager for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Browse movies, shows, collections, and book libraries; replace artwork; and manage custom NFO metadata.
Container.Description: PosterView provides one interface for managing media artwork across Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Browse movies, shows, collections, and book libraries such as manga; apply posters, backgrounds, banners, and logos from multiple screen and eReader providers; edit custom series NFO metadata; upload custom artwork; and revert earlier changes from apply history. Credentials are encrypted at rest, and application data persists in the configured Data path.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: poster artwork plex jellyfin emby theposterdb fanart tvdb anilist mediux

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the PosterView web UI

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: SQLite database, encryption key, settings, apply history, and persistent artwork caches

Config.Name: Media Path
Config.Description: Optional: Enables PosterView to read and manage metadata such as nfo files.

Config.Name: Require Login
Config.Description: false disables login for ALL connections, including reverse proxies and remote access. true requires administrator login unless local-network bypass is enabled in Settings. Defaults to false. Use only on a trusted network when disabled.

Config.Name: Administrator Username
Config.Description: Username when Require Login is true. Defaults to admin.

Config.Name: Administrator Password
Config.Description: Password for the PosterView sign-in screen. Leave blank to generate one in /config/admin-password.txt.
